# Scriptoscope

> A browser runtime for classic Mac Kaleidoscope themes. Chrome paints into canvas;
> page content and native form controls remain real HTML. Themes are separate
> original `.sit` / `.rsrc` archives decoded client-side.

## Choose the reader task

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/README.md): orientation, one complete hosted starter and adoption limits.
- [Decorate a page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/decorate-a-page.md): hosted example helper, markup vocabulary, picker/retheme, dropped schemes, modal recipe and vendoring. `mountExplicitPage` is a demo helper, not a package mount export.
- [Use npm in an application](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/npm-consumer.md): install, acquire a first-party theme, run the included Vite/TypeScript example, deploy at a nested URL, attach controls and clean up owned resources.
- [Render and manage windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/runtime-api.md): renderer-only entry, owned raster loading, imperative windows, native controls, measured display preparation and button composition.
- [Integration edge cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/integration-edge-cases.md): layout, CSS, lifecycle, framework and SSR integration.
- [Interaction reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/interaction.md): gestures, keyboard/touch behavior, events and targets.
- [Author a scheme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/authoring-a-scheme.md): create and validate a new Kaleidoscope resource fork.
- [Port a scheme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/porting-a-kaleidoscope-scheme.md): add an existing scheme with provenance.

## Live examples and API sources

- [Interactive demo](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/showcase.html).
- [Theme gallery](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/) and [manifest](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/themes-manifest.json): available slugs, labels and attribution.
- [Diagnostic inspector](https://khawkins98.github.io/scriptoscope/diagnostic.html): per-scheme resources and render inspection.
- [Public runtime exports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/src/index.ts) and [declarative exports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/src/declarative/index.ts): verify API names here; avoid duplicating a drifting export list in this discovery file.
- [Example host source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/demo/explicit-host.mjs): finite source selection and application-owned attach/detach, theme replacement and disconnect. It does not automatically discover later inserted controls.

## Contributor context

Runtime implementers must start with the [implementer brief](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/spec/engine/IMPLEMENTER-BRIEF.md)
and their assigned safe family specification. Its read scope overrides other
reading suggestions here; unresolved rules become spec questions.

- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, checks and contribution rules.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/CLAUDE.md): contributor orientation and working norms.
- [Project background](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/project-background.md): preservation, attribution, research boundaries and work tracking.
- [Project history](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/history.md) and [LEARNINGS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/LEARNINGS.md): historical decisions; verify applicability before using old advice.
- [Doc sweep](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/docs/doc-sweep.md): update the authoritative home for the affected task.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/CHANGELOG.md): versioned release and migration information.
- [License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/khawkins98/scriptoscope/main/LICENSE): project code is MIT; third-party material retains its own terms and per-bundle provenance.
